title: FireSong Anagama Wood Firing
summary: Participate in communal wood firings at FireSong Anagama held 3-4 times yearly. Potters bring bisqued and glazed work, wadded and ready. Participation includes helping with pre-firing prep (wood splitting, glazing), loading the kiln Thursday-Friday, stoking in 4-hour crew shifts during the 3-day firing Friday-Sunday, and unloading the following Friday. No experience or fees are specified; the site does not provide contact information or registration details.
commitment: Multi-day firing cycle: prep shifts, Fri load · Fri-Sun fire · Fri unload
bring: Bisqued pottery, glazed and wadded, ready to load
source_quote: It is fired 3-4 times a year by a community of artists who work in shifts, day and night, to feed the fire they hope will produce the signature markings that only a wood fired kiln can make.
evidence_sentence: The homepage states the kiln fires 3-4 times yearly with community artists working shifts to feed the fire.
evidence_quote: It is fired 3-4 times a year by a community of artists who work in shifts, day and night, to feed the fire
